Evidence: [src/core.ts:87](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-memory/blob/1dc5b66ee84cf89b68c5f007eb88e215372b766d/src/core.ts#L87), [src/core.ts:23](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-evidence/blob/3dfeaae8d43d16f8e34f0aaecc404d1724ed2c51/src/core.ts#L23), [index.ts:1710](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/blob/cdcd1e3f5e59db8b53cdfa5397e6d1ec18ef080d/index.ts#L1710) / [disclosure.ts:108](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/blob/cdcd1e3f5e59db8b53cdfa5397e6d1ec18ef080d/disclosure.ts#L108).

Problem: these packages repeatedly serialize their complete packet, stabilize a self-accounting field, fit rows under a budget and retain an omission receipt. Existing estimatePmOutputTokens, attachOutputTokenAccounting, packContextCandidates and universal read-output bounding cover related pieces, but none is a public generic fixed-point fitter for a caller-defined JSON/TOON envelope that must satisfy the larger rendering including its own receipt and newline. The SDK packer charges candidate projections, not arbitrary envelope bytes; token accounting intentionally measures pre-receipt bytes and discloses receipt overhead separately. Draft API: accept ordered candidates, renderers, a receipt/envelope builder, a deterministic prefix-or-skip policy and a minimum-envelope refusal policy; bound fitting work and report it. Acceptance: Unicode, differing JSON/TOON size order, digit-boundary self-accounting growth, a budget too small for the receipt, no split rows, and monotone deterministic omissions. Preserve domain-specific relevance and stronger one-token-per-byte limits rather than silently relaxing them.


Source: a read-only audit of 30 fleet extensions against the exported SDK of @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.10.23 (3,188 exported names); each of the three cited packages re-implements this primitive today.

Related: #1401 (CLI `pm context` envelope accounting); this asks for the generic SDK primitive extensions can call.
GH-1567: fit whole SDK envelopes using the selected serializer and token budget
External report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1567. Revalidate the reported 2026.10.23 behavior against the checkout before implementation.

Inspect existing read-output packing before adding a generic primitive; preserve mandatory envelope metadata and serializer-specific complete packet accounting; validate infeasible budgets and omission receipts
